items.description: Leak detection and opening of the bathroom wall next to the washbasin
items.rationale: Leak detection and wall opening are covered and necessary for the water escape damage.

items.description: Replacement of split copper supply pipe section, 15 mm, incl. fittings
items.rationale: Pipe replacement is covered and directly related to the fractured pipe damage.

items.description: Closing the wall opening, re-plastering and re-tiling approx. 0.2 m2
items.rationale: Restoration of plaster and tiles is covered and necessary to restore damage.

items.description: Annual service and descaling of the gas boiler in the hallway
items.rationale: Service and descaling of boiler is explicitly excluded and unrelated to the water damage.
